name: Creamy Soba Noodle Bowl with Rainbow Veggies

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water and bring to a boil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 medium carrots
¾ small head red cabbage
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and grate or mince the ginger; transfer to a large bowl.
Add peanut butter, honey, water, tamari, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and sesame oil to the bowl with the ginger. Whisk until smooth, set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp water
2 tbsp tamari soy sauce
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Once water is boiling, add salt and noodles and stir for a few seconds. Cook according to package directions, 3 to 4 minutes. When cooked, drain and rinse well under cold water.
instructions.secondary_message:
425 g soba (buckwheat) noodles
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ⅛-inch pieces at an angle.
Cut the bell pepper lengthwise into quarters; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane. Julienne the pepper.
Trim and discard the ends of the cucumber; halve the cucumber lengthwise and then slice into ⅛-inch thick planks. Then, cut the planks ¼-inch wide julienne sticks.
Trim the stem ends of the carrots and peel; julienne or coarsely grate the carrots.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.
Add noodles, cashews, and veggies to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
Divide noodles between plates, serve cold. Enjoy!
